places.name: Stopića Cave
places.ai_summary: A fascinating limestone cave featuring unique formations, underground waterfalls, and a serene ambiance, perfect for nature enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes as the cave floor can be slippery.

places.name: Drvengrad (Kustendorf Wooden Village)
places.ai_summary: A charming wooden village built by filmmaker Emir Kusturica, offering cultural events, traditional architecture, and scenic views.

opening_hours.notes: Cultural events may extend hours.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the local film screenings and workshops.

places.name: Tara National Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning national park known for its pristine nature, diverse wildlife, and the beautiful Drina River canyon.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal variations in hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the park's hiking trails and lookout points.

places.name: Zlatibor Ski Resort
places.ai_summary: A popular ski resort offering a variety of slopes for all skill levels, along with stunning mountain views.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary depending on snow conditions.

places.place_tip: Book ski passes in advance during peak season.

places.name: Sirogojno Open-Air Museum
places.ai_summary: An ethno-village museum showcasing traditional Serbian life, with authentic wooden houses, workshops, and farm animals.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available on request.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for traditional events and demonstrations.

places.name: Gostilje Waterfall
places.ai_summary: A beautiful waterfall located in a tranquil forest, ideal for a peaceful retreat and nature photography.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fewer crowds.

places.place_tip: Bring water and snacks, as facilities are limited.

places.name: Uvac Canyon (Meanders Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: A stunning viewpoint overlooking the meanders of the Uvac River, known for its dramatic cliffs and rich biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the short hike to the viewpoint.

places.name: Mokra Gora Scenic Railway
places.ai_summary: A historic narrow-gauge railway offering a scenic train ride through the picturesque landscapes of Mokra Gora.

opening_hours.notes: Check the timetable for train departures.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance, especially on weekends.

places.name: Kremna Village
places.ai_summary: A small village known for its traditional wooden houses and as the birthplace of the famous Serbian poet, Desanka Maksimović.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the local church and poet's house.

places.name: Zlatibor Adventure Park
places.ai_summary: An outdoor amusement park offering a variety of activities such as zip-lining, rope courses, and hiking trails.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for group activities.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes.

places.name: Dino Park Zlatibor
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly theme park featuring life-sized dinosaur replicas, a museum, and various entertainment options for children.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and workshops.

places.place_tip: Ideal for families with children.

places.name: Zlatibor Lake
places.ai_summary: A picturesque lake in the center of Zlatibor, perfect for a relaxing day by the water, with options for boating and fishing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a picnic by the lake or take a boat ride.

places.name: Mileseva Monastery
places.ai_summary: A Serbian Orthodox monastery known for its beautiful frescoes and peaceful surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Dress modestly when visiting the monastery.

places.place_tip: Take time to explore the monastery grounds and enjoy the tranquility.

places.name: Ribnica Lake
places.ai_summary: A serene lake surrounded by forests, ideal for fishing, picnicking, and enjoying nature.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring your own fishing gear if you plan to fish.

places.name: Uvac Nature Reserve
places.ai_summary: A protected area known for its stunning river canyon, rich biodiversity, and opportunities for outdoor activities.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise or sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking and exploring.

places.name: Mount Tornik Cable Car Ride
places.ai_summary: A cable car ride offering panoramic views of the Zlatibor mountain range and the surrounding landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Weather conditions may affect operation.

places.place_tip: Combine with a hike for a full-day adventure.

places.name: Local Honey & Cheese Markets
places.ai_summary: Markets offering a variety of local honey and cheese products, perfect for tasting and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal availability of products.

places.place_tip: Bring cash, as not all vendors may accept cards.

places.name: Zlatibor Ethno Village
places.ai_summary: A reconstructed ethno-village showcasing traditional Serbian architecture, lifestyle, and crafts.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available on request.

places.place_tip: Participate in a workshop to learn about traditional crafts.

places.name: Drvengrad Cinema & Café
places.ai_summary: A unique cinema and café located in the wooden village of Drvengrad, offering a cozy atmosphere and cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for film screenings.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee or snack at the café before or after the film.

places.name: Mountain Hiking Trails
places.ai_summary: Various hiking trails of different difficulty levels, offering stunning views of the Zlatibor mountain range and valleys.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and wear appropriate hiking gear.
